title: Discord Transport
purpose: Connects Intelligent Home modules to Discord and routes house messages.
description: Discord transport: holds the one bot token, reads each channel once (cursor + journal) and lets separate feature add-ons (ih_discord_house, ih_discord_shopping, ...) answer through a signed MQTT bus. No commands of its own since 0.7.0. Since 0.8.0 it can also administer channels for a module that is granted this (all off by default). DRY-RUN by default: a module writes to Discord only when dry_run is off and it is in live_modules. Maps no folders.
